resources.string: This folder is not located on the device\'s storage. Cloud services and virtual folders cannot be used as a game data location. Choose a folder on the internal storage or a mounted SD card.
Could not resolve the selected folder to a real directory path. Try selecting it again.
The root of a storage cannot be used as the game data location. Create a folder inside it (for example, xash) and select that folder instead.
The selected storage volume is unavailable. Make sure the SD card or USB drive is inserted and mounted.
The selected item is not a readable folder. Try selecting it again.
The selected folder is not writable. The engine needs to write saves and configuration files into the game data location, so read-only storages cannot be used.

Standard media folders such as DCIM, Pictures, Movies or Music cannot be used: a .nomedia marker file is created in the game data location, which would hide the contents of the folder from gallery and media player apps. Choose or create a separate folder for the games, for example in the root of the storage, and select it instead.

This folder is inside a media folder (such as DCIM, Pictures or Music) and contains other files. Using it would hide them from gallery and media player apps. Choose a separate folder for the games outside the media folders, for example in the root of the storage.
The contents of this folder cannot be read.
This device has no system folder picker.
Select the folder that contains game folders (for example, valve or cstrike), not one of the game folders itself.
The selected folder does not contain any game directories (folders with a liblist.gam or gameinfo.txt file). Use it as the game data location anyway?
All-files access is required for the app to function properly.
External storage access is required for the app to function properly.
To launch this game, you need additional APK installed
Crash details are attached. Please describe in as much detail as possible what you were doing when the game crashed — every little thing helps us fix it!
No email client is installed on this device. Install one (or use Share to send the report another way) and try again.
An error occurred while downloading game libraries.
A newer version of the game libraries is available. Download the update?

Failed to download the build manifest:

%1$s

Game libraries cannot be downloaded right now. You can launch the engine anyway, but it likely won't find the game DLLs.
To install the update, allow Xash3D FWGS to install unknown apps in system settings.
You\'re already on the latest build.
Couldn\'t check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
